buildings.finding: Three occupied levels, exact sash schedules and the capped crow-step remain image-locked. Round two adds a paneled oak door, glazed diamond fanlight and black masonry anchors instead of flat dark placeholders.

The image-locked roof and real open bays now gain continuous brick piers plus counters, crates, produce and warm task lights on all four frontages. Fine iron ornament and photographic entourage remain provisional.
